threads.body: This lock file is auto-generated by `gh aw compile` (see the `DO NOT EDIT` banner at line 17), but it looks like it was edited by hand: while the step here was updated to v3.2.0 / `client-id`, the generated header metadata at the top of the file is now stale. The `gh-aw-manifest` on line 2 still lists `actions/create-github-app-token` with the old `sha":"1b10c78c...","version":"v3.1.1"`, and the `frontmatter_hash` on line 1 was computed from the old frontmatter (the `finalize` job lives inside the `module-cleanup.md` frontmatter, which ends at line 207). Since `check-gh-aw-lockfiles` recompiles all workflows and runs `git diff --exit-code` (build-common.yml:175-209), the regenerated header will differ and fail that check. Regenerate this file with `gh aw compile` after editing `module-cleanup.md` instead of editing the lock file directly.
threads.hunk:
@@ -1072,9 +1072,9 @@ jobs:
           GH_HOST="${GH_HOST#http://}"
           echo "GH_HOST=${GH_HOST}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
       - id: otelbot-token
-        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@1b10c78c7865c340bc4f6099eb2f838309f1e8c3 # v3.1.1
+        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
         with:
-          app-id: ${{ vars.OTELBOT_JAVA_INSTRUMENTATION_APP_ID }}
+          client-id: ${{ vars.OTELBOT_JAVA_INSTRUMENTATION_CLIENT_ID }}
